desc: Ideate candidate approaches and select the sweep + lazy segment tree as primary.
Read input and compute prefix distinct counts pref[1..N].
Implement lazy segment tree over left split positions supporting range add and range max query.
Sweep right split j, activate i=j-1 with pref[i], update ranges where A[j] newly contributes to middle distinct count using previous occurrence.
For each valid j (2..N-1), query max active i plus suff[j+1] and update answer.
Test edge cases N=3, all equal, all distinct, and sample cases.
If segment tree is too slow/complex, implement sqrt-decomposition fallback.
